title: The Qur’an, Isra and Mi‘raj
intro: The lasting miracle of the Qur’an, and the night journey of the Prophet (SAW).

learn.title: 📖 The Qur’an – the lasting miracle
learn.html: The Qur’an is the greatest miracle of Muhammad (SAW). Allah challenged people to bring even one surah like it, and no one has ever been able to. It has been kept unchanged for more than 1,400 years – in the hearts of hafiz, in writing, and in our recitation every day.

In one night, by Allah’s will, the Prophet (SAW) travelled from Al-Masjid al-Haram in Makkah to Al-Masjid al-Aqsa in Jerusalem, with the angel Jibril, riding Al-Buraq. There he led all the prophets in prayer. Allah tells us about this journey at the start of Surah Al-Isra (Qur’an, Al-Isra 17:1).

From Jerusalem the Prophet (SAW) was taken up through the seven heavens. In the heavens he met earlier prophets, among them Adam, ‘Isa, Yusuf, Idris, Harun, Musa and Ibrahim (peace be upon them). He reached Sidrat al-Muntaha, the furthest point of the heavens.

learn.title: 🕌 The gift of Mi‘raj – five daily prayers
learn.html: On the night of Mi‘raj Allah made the five daily prayers a duty for Muslims. That is why Salah is sometimes called the mi‘raj of the believer – in it we come close to Allah.

learn.title: 🤝 Abu Bakr as-Siddiq
learn.html: When the Prophet (SAW) told people about the journey, many in Makkah did not believe him. Abu Bakr said at once: “If he said it, it is true.” From then on he was called as-Siddiq – the one who confirms the truth.

Al-Masjid al-Aqsa – Jerusalem, the end of the Isra
Laylat al-Mi‘raj – remembered on the 27th night of Rajab

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: Isra = Makkah → Jerusalem. Mi‘raj = Jerusalem → the heavens. Its gift is the five daily prayers.
